title: Triumphal Entry and Cleansing the Temple

questions.question: When they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, Jesus sent two disciples to find what in the village ahead?
options: A colt tied, on which no one has ever sat
A white horse ready for battle
A cart filled with wheat for the Passover
A room furnished and ready for the meal
questions.correctAnswer: A colt tied, on which no one has ever sat
questions.explanation: Mark 11:2 (ESV): "...and said to them, 'Go into the village in front of you, and immediately as you enter it you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it.'"

questions.question: If anyone asked why they were untying the colt, what were the disciples instructed to say?
options: "The Lord has need of it and will send it back here immediately."
"We have purchased it from the master of the house."
"It is required for the feast of the Passover."
"It belongs to Jesus of Nazareth."
questions.correctAnswer: "The Lord has need of it and will send it back here immediately."
questions.explanation: Mark 11:3 (ESV): "If anyone says to you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord has need of it and will send it back here immediately.'"

questions.question: What did the people shout as Jesus rode into Jerusalem on the colt?
options: "Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"
"King of Kings, Savior of Israel!"
"The Prophet has come down from the mountain!"
"We praise the Son of Man!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"
questions.explanation: Mark 11:9 (ESV): "And those who went before and those who followed were shouting, 'Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'"

questions.question: The next morning, coming from Bethany, Jesus was hungry. What did He find on the fig tree in leaf?
options: He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs
He found rotten figs unfit to eat
He found only a single small fig on the lowest branch
He found the tree had been pruned completely
questions.correctAnswer: He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs
questions.explanation: Mark 11:13 (ESV): "...he went to see if he could find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs."

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the fig tree?
options: "May no one ever eat fruit from you again."
"May your roots rot and your leaves fall immediately."
"Bear no fruit until the Son of Man returns."
"Cursed is every tree that bears no fruit."
questions.correctAnswer: "May no one ever eat fruit from you again."
questions.explanation: Mark 11:14 (ESV): "And he said to it, 'May no one ever eat fruit from you again.' And his disciples heard it."

questions.question: When Jesus entered the temple and began to drive out those who sold and bought, He overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold what?
options: Pigeons
Sheep
Incense
Oxen
questions.explanation: Mark 11:15 (ESV): "...and he overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold pigeons."

questions.question: What else did Jesus restrict people from doing while He cleansed the temple?
options: He would not allow anyone to carry anything through the temple
He would not allow anyone to sing the Psalms of Ascent
He would not allow women into the outer courtyard
He would not allow the priests to offer the daily sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: He would not allow anyone to carry anything through the temple
questions.explanation: Mark 11:16 (ESV): "And he would not allow anyone to carry anything through the temple."

questions.question: Quoting Scripture, Jesus said, "Is it not written, 'My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations'? But you have made it a..." what?
options: Den of robbers
Market of thieves
Cave of hiding
House of trade
questions.explanation: Mark 11:17 (ESV): "And he was teaching them and saying to them... 'But you have made it a den of robbers.'"

questions.question: Why did the chief priests and the scribes seek a way to destroy Jesus after He cleansed the temple?
options: Because they feared Him, because all the crowd was astonished at His teaching
Because He challenged their wealth and prestige directly
Because they thought He was attempting to incite a Roman rebellion
Because He threw their sacrificial animals out of the gate
questions.correctAnswer: Because they feared Him, because all the crowd was astonished at His teaching
questions.explanation: Mark 11:18 (ESV): "And the chief priests and the scribes heard it and were seeking a way to destroy him, for they feared him, because all the crowd was astonished at his teaching."

questions.question: As they passed by in the morning, what did the disciples notice about the fig tree Jesus had cursed?
options: They saw the fig tree withered away to its roots
They saw the fig tree bursting with unnatural fruit
They saw the tree had been chopped down by a woodsman
They saw the leaves had fallen, leaving bare branches
questions.correctAnswer: They saw the fig tree withered away to its roots
questions.explanation: Mark 11:20 (ESV): "As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away to its roots."

questions.question: When Peter pointed out the withered tree, Jesus told them to "Have faith in God." What miraculous example did He use to emphasize the power of faith without doubting?
options: "Whoever says to this mountain, 'Be taken up and thrown into the sea...'"
"Whoever tells this ocean to part..."
"Whoever commands the sun to stand still in the sky..."
"Whoever commands a dead man to rise..."
questions.correctAnswer: "Whoever says to this mountain, 'Be taken up and thrown into the sea...'"
questions.explanation: Mark 11:23 (ESV): "Truly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, 'Be taken up and thrown into the sea,' and does not doubt in his heart..."

questions.question: Jesus teaches: "Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it..." and what will be the result?
options: "...and it will be yours."
"...and God will consider your plea."
"...and it might be given if it is lawful."
"...and you shall find peace in the asking."
questions.explanation: Mark 11:24 (ESV): "Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours."

questions.question: According to Jesus in Mark 11:25, what should you do whenever you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father may forgive your trespasses?
options: Forgive him
Go and offer a sacrifice of repentance
Speak the wrong loudly so others may judge
Demand restitution before the sun sets
questions.explanation: Mark 11:25 (ESV): "And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses."

questions.question: When the chief priests, scribes, and elders asked Jesus by what authority He did these things, with what question did Jesus counter?
options: "Was the baptism of John from heaven or from man?"
"Was Moses given the law by angels or by his own mind?"
"Did David conquer Jerusalem by the sword or by the Spirit?"
"By what authority do you sit in the seat of Moses?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Was the baptism of John from heaven or from man?"
questions.explanation: Mark 11:30 (ESV): "Was the baptism of John from heaven or from man? Answer me."

questions.question: How did the Jewish leaders eventually answer Jesus' question about John the Baptist?
options: "We do not know."
"From man."
"From heaven."
"It was a deception of the devil."
questions.explanation: Mark 11:33 (ESV): "So they answered Jesus, 'We do not know.' And Jesus said to them, 'Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.'"

key_verse_text: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
